note: The bar this kit is measured against, as a record and not as pixels. Mobbin licences a screenshot to its subscriber, and this is public source, so no image byte is committed here: each entry names the bytes in the reference store, and `npm run check:references` proves the store still holds exactly those bytes. The `why` column is why the screen was chosen for this family; `ours` is what the kit draws today against it, which is the gap the review looks at.

entries.why: Phone rows carrying key, priority chevron, status pill and date in a small footprint under a saved-view selector.
entries.ours: Row carries an eyebrow, a title, up to two cell lines and one trailing element; nothing reserves a right-aligned date column or a status pill beside it, and Section has no group header with a count.

entries.why: Watchlist card with total change, rows of ticker, name, sparkline and coloured change pill, plus Add symbol and Edit list: the phone watchlist.
entries.ours: StatTile, Sparkline and Badge draw those three pieces, and Sparkline's picture is decoration rather than a DOM attribute since 4abccdd; the row that holds ticker, name and sparkline in one measure is the composition the app writes, and the gallery shows them one specimen apart.

entries.why: One large card for the book in progress, its progress bar and a single "Playing · 18 min left" button; the mini player persists while browsing.
entries.ours: MiniPlayer holds cover, title, elapsed and remaining and one control, collapsed over a list and expanded with its scrubber; its controls are now named in the person's language and reachable one by one (fe19dc4), and its artwork is the caller's, so a photographed strip is only as real as the picture the app supplies.
